title: Centrifugal pump assembly DFMEA
goal: Present failure modes, effects, causes, controls, and computed risk priorities for a centrifugal pump.

rubric.must: The worksheet visibly identifies the centrifugal pump assembly and its flow-and-pressure function.
Mechanical seal leakage, insufficient flow, and bearing seizure visibly have linked effects and causes.
Each visible failure row has severity, occurrence, detection, and computed RPN or action-priority risk fields.
Prevention and detection controls are visibly shown for the listed causes.
Seal leakage and insufficient flow visibly have more than one cause row.
High-priority risk rows are visually distinguished from lower-priority rows.
The table has readable headers and aligned score columns.

ideal.notes: Independently authored against visual-eval/exemplars/fmea/ideal.svg (sha256 656f156ad4fb), source sha256 227f6fbfbd7b. Independent worksheet with all causes, effects, controls and scores. Adjacent repeated cells merged; AP or RPN follows the source ranking method. AP values checked against the AIAG-VDA 2019 matrix documented by HBK ReliaSoft, https://reliasoftcloud.hbkworld.com/demo/help/content/risk_ranking_logic.htm, not the engine approximation. RPN is multiplied independently; no AP invented for the RPN-only case. All 21 risk-batch targets were rasterised with Resvg and visually inspected individually on 2026-09-14; this drawing was accepted for geometry, label readability and semantic traceability.
